title: Reproducibility Package for Metric Divergence and Anti-Gaming Diagnostics for Streaming Acoustic Echo Cancellation
description: Frozen reproducibility package for the TASLP manuscript Metric Divergence and Anti-Gaming Diagnostics for Streaming Acoustic Echo Cancellation. The package contains the v32 manuscript submission archive, generated tables and figures, returned item-level listening-summary aggregates, selected validation snapshots, and lightweight packaging/validation scripts. It excludes raw third-party challenge audio, generated audio clips, private checkpoints, caches, and credentials.
